summary: Pins kb repair to report-only behaviour and records the kbWrite call shapes this session had to discover the hard way. THE TRAPS, all verified by running them: an absence lesson with no scope.terms is REJECTED by kbWrite outright, so missing-scope-terms can only ever fire on notes predating that validation — the test therefore exercises that predicate against a synthetic folded note instead of trying to write one. A retract needs BOTH type/path AND target:{kind:'note'} or it errors out. A file-hub that supplies facets needs no anchors[].symbols because write.ts unions every facet symbol into the anchor. One test snapshots every .raw log before and after planning+rendering to prove repair appends nothing.

summary: Covers kb repair: planRepairs/repairWorklist (pure, never writes) and mechanicalSymbolRepair (the one writing path). Verified 2026-08-03: the mechanical block seeds a fake sidecar directly via saveKbNotesIndex, so no real code index is needed. Two tests added for the wrong-note backfill bug — one asserts a secondary anchor (created by listing a second path in `verified`) is skipped, no note is conjured at its path, and a second pass fixes nothing; the other asserts a note already carrying aliasesVerified stays out of planAliasRepair after a backfill. The convergence assertion is the load-bearing one: a non-converging pass is what trips the keeper's streak cap.
